title: Build a category tree
description: Convert flat category records into a nested tree. A record with parentId null is a root. Attach children in input order. If a parentId does not exist, treat that record as a root. Every returned node must contain a fresh children array and the input records must not be mutated.
signature: export function buildCategoryTree(items: readonly { id: string; parentId: string | null; name: string }[]): Array<{ id: string; parentId: string | null; name: string; children: Array<{ id: string; parentId: string | null; name: string; children: unknown[] }> }>
